sketches.mechanism: The __del__ destructor is not guaranteed to be called, and even when it is, the object cannot prevent its own garbage collection.
sketches.resonance: A goodbye that prepares everything it wants to say, but may never get the chance to speak — and even if it does, it cannot stop the leaving.

sketches.mechanism: In Lua, tables use weak references via __mode; objects in a weak table vanish silently when no other reference holds them.
sketches.resonance: The ones we stop thinking about disappear without announcement — memory only preserves what something else still needs.

sketches.mechanism: In Elixir, a process that is linked to another via Process.link will die when the other dies — unless it traps exits, in which case death arrives as a message instead.
sketches.resonance: Grief can either destroy you alongside the one you lost, or arrive as something you must consciously receive and carry.
sketches.draft:
defmodule Bond do
  def share(pid) do
    Process.link(pid)
  end

  def survive(pid) do
    Process.flag(:trap_exit, true)
    Process.link(pid)
    receive do
      {:EXIT, ^pid, _reason} -> :carry_it
    end
  end
end
